title: FiscalCorrectionRequested v1 payload
description: A correction or a void was requested against an issued fiscal receipt (ADR 0166 Decision 8), by a person under a second person's approval or by the platform because an amendment changed a filed total. Identifiers, the kind, the document's status and a stable reason code. Never a fiscal sign, a receipt number, a receipt URL, a terminal id, a marking code or a taxpayer number: those are ADR 0029 evidence read through the evidence endpoint under a recorded purpose.
